exposure: high levels of soluble fms-like tyrosine kinase 1 (sFlt-1)
outcome: urgent cesarean sections for HD/FGR complications
cohort: 39 women with multiple pregnancies hospitalized for hypertensive disorders (HD) and/or fetal growth restriction (FGR) after the 20th gestational week
finding: In multiple pregnancies complicated by HD/FGR, a sFlt-1 cutoff of ≥ 15,802 pg/mL could predict adverse obstetric outcomes.
